text:
Priya: Kicking off a quick thread to finalise DP success SLOs for the upcoming Private Beta with AcmeHealth. Theyre asking for 99.5% inference uptime + 200ms p95 E2E. We cant guarantee that on shared infra. Proposal: tiered SLAs (Gold: 99.5% / 200ms on dedicated reservation; Silver: 99% / 500ms on shared). Thoughts?
Derek: Tiering seems fair. Also we need to factor in their data residency ask  on-prem for PHI  that changes delivery model.
Nico: Engineering note: 200ms p95 for long-context (8k) chat is unrealistic on quantized models on current Ampere nodes. We should condition latency SLO on avg token/req. Suggest SLO only when avg_seq_len < 1024, otherwise use Silver.
Hannah: From CS: success criteria must include qualitative checkpoints: weekly feedback calls for the first 30 days + two product-health signals met (latency and error-rate). Also require a clear rollback plan for the partner.
Priya: Draft acceptance checklist: 1) signed DP MoU (scope + SLAs); 2) infra readiness (capacity reserved + test harness); 3) eval dataset & sample prompts from partner; 4) monitoring dashboard + alerting; 5) runbook for escalations and rollback.
Derek: Who owns the MoU? legal-bot: assigning to Legal (Aisha). Also flag: export-control and model licensing review if we ship any model artifacts.
Aisha: Noted. Ill prepare DP addendum template and highlight data residency and audit clauses. Need product to supply expected data flows.
Nico: Ops note: dedicated capacity requires monthly commit and ~2w lead for provisioning. Private on-prem installs require scheduling with infra team. ETA impacts timeline.
Hannah: Metrics proposal: Primary = % of production requests meeting target latency & no error; Secondary = partner NPS after 30 days; Tertiary = delta in $/1k tokens. Include qualitative note counts too.
Priya: Proposed acceptance thresholds: Gold = >=99.5% uptime AND >=90% requests meet latency; Silver = >=99% uptime AND >=75% meet latency. Exit criteria: if <70% meet latency for 7 consecutive days, trigger remediation meeting and potential DP termination.
Derek: Also need to agree retention windows and log access. Partner wants logs purged daily; we can do that but need a debug retention exception process.
Priya: Quick operational asks: who owns monitoring dashboard, who owns alert escalation, and what's the incident SLA for partner-facing outages?
Nico: Engineering will own dashboard build; Ops will own alerts and on-call routing. Incident SLA proposal: acknowledge within 30m, update every 1h until resolved for P1.
Hannah: Ill own partner coordination and weekly feedback calls. Ill also capture UX notes and track partner sentiment.
Priya: Can we do a fast poll here: react :thumbsup: to accept tiered SLA plan, :thinking: to request edits, :thumbsdown: to veto.
legal-bot: MoU draft uploaded: /docs/templates/dp_mou_v3.md (Aisha assigned).
Nico: I'll create the JIRA epics for Gold vs Silver delivery and post estimates. Roughly 3w for Gold (procurement + infra + test), 1w for Silver (config + monitoring).
Aisha: Ill send initial DP addendum draft by EOD Monday. Please DM data flow details.
Priya: Thanks  presenting to AcmeHealth on Tuesday. Owners: Priya (PM), Nico (Eng), Aisha (Legal), Hannah (CS), Derek (Ops). Re-open thread here if you hit blockers.
Priya: Quick follow-up: poll mostly :thumbsup: with a couple :thinking:. Proceeding to present but will surface the :thinking: points during the meeting.
